body:
It seems there is extra comma in "time-based, one-time passwords" in 6.5.1, 6.5.5, 6.5.8 in [6.5](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/5.0/en/0x15-V6-Authentication.md#v65-general-multi-factor-authentication-requirements). 
For example for 6.5.5 instead of 

> Verify that out-of-band authentication requests, codes, or tokens, as well as time-based, one-time passwords (TOTPs) have a defined lifetime.

should be 

> Verify that out-of-band authentication requests, codes, or tokens, as well as time-based one-time passwords (TOTPs) have a defined lifetime.

And to same approach in this part, suggest putting "Time based One-time Passwords (TOTPs)" instead on "time-based, one-time passwords (TOTPs)" in 6.5.1, 6.5.5, 6.5.8.

comments.body: I don't want to change the phrasing but I agree the comma fix is needed, thanks!
